title: Patent Granted for AI-Powered Accessibility Assistant System
desc: Received a patent grant from Intellectual Property India for the project 'An AI-Powered Accessibility Assistant System for the Visually Impaired', developed during an internship with MiT Square, London. The project focused on leveraging AI-driven accessibility technologies to assist visually impaired individuals through intelligent assistance and real-time interaction systems.

title: HiveMind SIST – AI/ML Innovation Community Initiative
desc: Collaborated as part of HiveMind SIST, a student-driven AI/ML innovation community at Sathyabama School of Computing, where 17 passionate innovators worked together on impactful projects spanning healthcare AI, synthetic data generation, automotive intelligence, surveillance systems, and anti-forgery technologies. The initiative fostered collaboration, research, creativity, and hands-on problem-solving under the mentorship of industry and academic experts.

title: Industry–Academia Meet 2.0 on AI in Drug Discovery & Diagnostics
desc: Participated in the Industry–Academia Meet 2.0 on AI in Drug Discovery and Diagnostics Development held at Sathyabama Institute of Science & Technology, Chennai, in collaboration with Molecular Solutions Software Pvt Ltd., Bengaluru. Presented a project on 'Multimodal Analysis for Hypertrophic Cardiomyopathy' exploring AI-driven approaches for early diagnosis and healthcare innovation, gaining exposure to real-world biomedical research and industry collaboration.

title: AI Supercomputing Lab Industry Interaction with Matrimony.com
desc: Participated in an industry–academia interaction session at the AI Supercomputing Lab, Sathyabama Institute of Science & Technology, Chennai, during the visit of the Matrimony.com Limited team. Showcased innovative AI projects, exchanged ideas with industry professionals, and gained valuable exposure to real-world perspectives on AI innovation, research, and technology-driven problem solving.

title: First Hackathon Experience at VIT Chennai
desc: Participated in our first hackathon hosted by Vellore Institute of Technology (VIT) Chennai, gaining valuable hands-on experience in problem-solving, teamwork, rapid development, and collaborative innovation. The event provided exposure to real-world technical challenges, critical thinking, and continuous learning in a competitive hackathon environment.

title: AI/ML Innovation Initiative – 87 Projects in 3 Weeks
desc: Collaborated as part of a 24-member AI/ML and Data Science team from Sathyabama School of Computing to develop 87 projects within three weeks, focusing on domains such as Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), chatbot systems, healthcare AI, decision-making systems, and synthetic data generation. The initiative emphasized rapid innovation, collaborative learning, and hands-on experience in Artificial Intelligence, Deep Learning, and Generative AI.

title: UOC Engineering & Technology Program – University of Cyberjaya, Malaysia
desc: Participated in the UOC Engineering & Technology Program at the University of Cyberjaya, Malaysia, as part of an internship with MiT Square, London. Engaged in collaborative engineering and technology sessions, presented AI-based project ideas and prototypes, and explored real-world healthcare infrastructure through an industry visit to Cyberjaya Hospital, gaining international exposure to innovation, research, and interdisciplinary collaboration.

title: Machine Learning & Deep Learning Internship – Sathyabama School of Computing
desc: Completed a one-week internship program organized by the School of Computing at Sathyabama Institute of Science and Technology, focused on the fundamentals of Machine Learning and Deep Learning. The program provided hands-on exposure to AI concepts, learning methodologies, and practical applications through guided mentorship and interactive technical sessions.
